interop-native

First-party native Tiinex interoperability — provider-agnostic bootstrap, grounding, external tool/capability contracts and automation surfaces over Tiinex Core.

Grounding boundary:
- Start from `.topics/.workspaces/tiinex-interop-native.workspace.md` and the Workspace fresh-start Reduction under `.topics/reductions/workspace/`.
- Historical refactor work is reduced; no prior refactor Task is current. Future Interop Native work starts from a new explicit bounded Task with truthful Project ancestry.
- OpenAI-specific environment behavior belongs in `interop-openai`; shared semantic mechanics remain in Core.
